title: Cost-saving guidance tiles, granular config preview, and apply ledger
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running production workloads struggle to adopt batching and KV-cache recommendations because the console presents suggestions as opaque items with limited preview and no clear rollback provenance. This leads to manual adoption, missed savings, and fear of breaking SLAs when applying config changes to Dedicated/Private deployments.

Goal: Deliver a cohesive UX surfaced in the Optimize tab that: (1) presents suggestion tiles with clear projected unit-cost and latency impact, (2) provides a granular, line-level preview of configuration diffs (including expected runtime/quantization changes and sampling of affected routes), and (3) records a tamper-evident apply ledger with who/when/why and an automated revert flow that can be executed safely within a configurable window.

Non-goals: Automatic, fully automated apply without human review (we will support canary and staged applies but not fully autonomous changes in this ticket). Deep runtime implementation of batching engine changes — we assume existing runtime APIs (ENG) are available to apply suggested config bundles.
acceptance_criteria: Guidance tiles: Each suggestion tile displays: expected monthly token cost delta, median p95 latency delta, confidence band, and primary levers (batch size, cache TTL, quantization profile)
Preview diffs: Clicking ‘Preview’ shows a line-level diff of the JSON config along with a human-readable summary and a sampled list of 5 affected routes/teams; no apply button in preview-only mode

Apply ledger: After applying a suggestion, an immutable ledger entry is created with user, timestamp, change bundle, pre/post config snapshot links, and an auto-generated rollback button available for 72 hours
Safe-apply flow: The apply flow supports canary percentage, staged rollout schedule, and automatic fallback to previous model variant on regression alerts
Audit & export: Admins can export the apply ledger for a given org-month in CSV and each entry links to the exact PR/Config artifact stored in the config-store service
E2E: Manual QA verifies apply -> canary -> staged completion with an intentional simulated regression which triggers automatic fallback and ledger entry for the fallback
engineering_notes: Backend: new endpoint POST /optimize/apply-bundle (ENG-8421) will accept bundle_id, canary_pct, schedule and return ledger_id; ENG to provide schema by 2026-03-12
Preview: frontend will request a dry-run: GET /optimize/bundles/:id/preview which returns config diff plus sample routes and cost estimate metadata
Auth: apply ledger entries must be write-audit logged and include request_id for cross-service traceability; integrate with current audit-log service
Rollbacks: rollback is implemented by applying the stored pre-config snapshot; will require idempotent apply and safety checks to reject rollbacks that conflict with newer dependent changes
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta) — 2 engineers + PD: enable tiles and preview for 3 internal teams (expected 1 week)
Phase 2 (customer pilot) — enable apply + short ledger retention (90 days) for 5 pilot customers; monitor cost/latency delta and UX feedback (2 weeks)
Phase 3 (general availability) — full release with CSV export and 72-hour rollback window; include in release notes and create migration docs (1 sprint)
Monitoring: add dashboard for applied bundles, rollback rate, and average time-to-rollback
